role: The breeding or healing heart: grows over 16 ticks.
scope_reason: In scope like the other particle classes: 'heart' (animals in love and breeding, EntityAnimal.java:129/191/433) and 'angryVillager' (EntityVillager.java:663) build it on the client at the All and Decreased particle settings, each construction spending client draws.

members.name: EntityHeartFX
members.note: EntityFX(x,y,z,0,0,0), motion x0.01 and +0.1 up, scale 0.75 x 2, sixteen ticks, texture 80; "angryVillager" is the same at y + 0.5 with texture 81 and white

notes: No behavior is ported. The scene renderer csrc/engine/raster_particles.c draws whatever class names the recorded state dump lists (base quads or icon quads), so a dump containing this class would render, but nothing constructs or ticks it natively. idxaudit 2026-09-27: was client_cosmetic/not_applicable; the scope reason did not hold (DEVLOG 2026-09-27, lane/idxaudit). fx_client feeds a cow (its client copy's seven hearts, S1A status 18). The angryVillager branch (status 13 needs a villager in a village) is proven only through the shared constructor; its two extra lines (y + 0.5, texture 81) are read from RenderGlobal.doSpawnParticle. lane/idxlast 2026-09-27: proven by the rendertick scene fx_client (seed 1, --particles 0, 143 ticks, 3,923 FX compared field by field against the oracle's dump, test_rendertick); it fails with the class changed (a negative control of 80 mismatches).
